payoff_convention: Small-blind chip EV relative to the start of the hand: fold = -small blind; uncalled shove = +big blind; called shove = (2 * equity - 1) * effective stack. Equal stacks, no ante, no rake.

validation.note: Status remains approximate because showdown equities are Monte Carlo estimates. NashConv is an exact best-response certificate only for the independently sampled evaluation payoff matrix; equity intervals are separate, non-simultaneous sampling advisories.
